task_description: Implement Phase 1 (Orchestration core foundations, tasks.md P1.1-P1.7) of the agent-harbor hybrid-orchestrator: domain models + mirrored TS types, sqlx SQLite persistence with versioned migrations + repositories + AppConfig schema_version, keyring-backed SecretStore with SecretRef handles (no plaintext leaks; CI-safe in-memory impl), SessionManager with per-conversation write lock, CoreEvent variants, and a validated Tauri command/event skeleton plus set_provider_secret. Offline sandbox is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY (crates.io/npm 403); crates gaining crates.io deps (sqlx/keyring/serde/tokio) are verified in CI (authoritative), mirroring the Phase 0 tauri-app exclude pattern. Work on branch phase-1-core-foundations off main.
